summary: Six locally hosted, photographic WebP assets depicting athletic training floor layout, selectorized strength machines, Olympic barbell deadlift technique, kettlebell functional conditioning, free-weight dumbbell rack, and commercial cardiovascular endurance treadmills under verified CC0 / Creative Commons licenses.
concept_notice: No real fitness club, actual member results, coach roster, branches or bookable slots. Demonstration concept by Mavvix.
